name: Santa María de los Caballeros (Spain)
description: Square blue flag charged at the centre with a white vase of lilies, within a red border bearing five yellow spurs, in the composition of the municipal arms.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 26 April 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 86 of 7 May 1999); the flag is square of proportion 1:1, a blue cloth with a white vase of lilies at the centre and a red border with five yellow spurs, in a composition identical to that of the arms, the finial of the staff being a vase with lilies.

features.role: broad border with five yellow spurs
